card.name: Inside numbers with decimals
card.fires_on: Digits or the decimal point in the middle of a multi-digit number, usually after a first digit or two. It appears in measurements, doses, prices and statistics.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The period inside a number between whole and fractional digits.
modes.example: The dose can be adjusted between a minimum of 20<<.>>25 mg of testosterone

modes.label: Digit within a number
modes.description: A digit partway through a longer number, often before a unit.
modes.example: each 300 mg tablet of CUVRIOR contains 1<<5>>0 mg of trientine base

modes.label: Fraction slash
modes.description: A slash in a ratio or odds figure after a leading digit.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a number, such as at the decimal point or a digit in a dose, price or measurement.
